recommendations.rationale: 78% of TR6 fresh wins are static-compatible (already RC4 or fixable by allowlist/gate/schema work) but 22% require theorem-specific retrieved lemmas (tauto/rw/exact families) that cannot become a small static allowlist. RC4 static is safe and reproduces the validated component wins; the fresh out-of-sample delta needs the TR6 ranker-guided dynamic retrieval that found per-theorem lemmas. Keep RC4 static as the deterministic core and add a gated ranker-guided dynamic retrieval stage for the dynamic tail.
recommendations.expected_benefit: recovers the fresh-frontier generalization RC4 static lacks without losing RC4's safety/determinism on the static core.
recommendations.risk: dynamic retrieval reintroduces nondeterminism + probe cost; must be gated and owner-billed; ranker is namespace-specific (TR4/TR6 caveat).
recommendations.required_validation: RC5 hybrid benchmark = RC4 static floors/known-wins preserved + ranker-guided dynamic stage measured on a FRESH frontier with SX4-style attribution; determinism scoped to the static core.
recommendations.next_task: RC5H — Hybrid static+ranker wrapper prototype & fresh-frontier benchmark

recommendations.rationale: RC4A def-unfold gate fires 76× and closes only 7 (precision 0.092); it fires on every monotone/antitone theorem. Tighten to the iff-unfold shape (require `_iff_` in the name) to cut wasted emissions. Additive/safe today, so low urgency, but it is the loosest component.
recommendations.expected_benefit: less wasted probe budget; cleaner precision before any expansion.
recommendations.risk: tightening could drop a future iff-unfold win — validate additively.
recommendations.required_validation: re-run RC4A external-additive eval with the tightened gate; confirm 0 lost wins, lower fire count.
recommendations.next_task: folded into RC5H or a standalone RC4A-gate patch

recommendations.rationale: 3 TR6 wins use clean single-occurrence lemmas (['Finset.biUnion_subset', 'Finset.subset_iff', 'Set.MapsTo']) that are allowlist-expansion candidates but lack repeat / namespace-parametric evidence. A larger fresh sweep would tell whether they recur (→ static) or stay one-off (→ dynamic).
recommendations.expected_benefit: resolves the allowlist-expansion-vs-dynamic question for the tail.
recommendations.risk: more compute; may still be inconclusive.
recommendations.required_validation: TR6-style ranked live sweep over a larger fresh pool, count recurrence of these lemmas.
recommendations.next_task: TR8 — larger fresh-frontier sweep focused on the candidate lemmas
